plain_english: Bow to you, ender of death, crusher of love, Gaṅgā on head, doer of what is right as fitting.
sanskrit_cite: namaḥ kṛtakṛtāntānta tubhyaṃ madanamardine mastakanyastagaṅgāya yathāyuktārthakāriṇe

plain_english: Above even lordship, knowledge, dispassion, dharmas — the standing prayed for: without you, O lord, what higher resort for those praying?
sanskrit_cite: aiśvaryajñānavairāgyadharmebhyo 'py upari sthitim nātha prārthayamānānāṃ tvad ṛte kā parā gatiḥ

plain_english: When you do not will, who is capable, O Śambhu, to bend grass? But favoured by your will — who would not carry Brahmā's yoke?
sanskrit_cite: tvayy anicchati kaḥ śambho śaktaḥ kubjayituṃ tṛṇam tvadicchānugṛhītas tu vahed brāhmīṃ dhuraṃ na kaḥ

plain_english: Heads raised with jewel-crowns of bowing to Hara — the wisdom-rich: to what supreme would they bow, or whom would they not bend?
sanskrit_cite: harapraṇatimāṇikyamukuṭotkaṭamastakāḥ nameyuḥ kaṃ paraṃ kaṃ vā namayeyur na dhīdhanāḥ

plain_english: Tremorless, shed of all wandering, nectar-lake — the middle of your knowledge-ocean — may I dwell upon, O Dhūrjaṭi.
sanskrit_cite: sarvavibhramanirmokaniṣkampam amṛtahradam bhavajjñānāmbudher madhyam adhyāsīyāpi dhūrjaṭe

plain_english: Wonder that — even strangely seen, even gone into wish — ultimate fruit, O lord, full you grant.
sanskrit_cite: citraṃ yac citradṛṣṭo 'pi manorathagato 'pi vā paramārthaphalaṃ nātha paripūrṇaṃ prayacchasi

plain_english: Who is greater than you by virtues? Who attributeless greater than you? Thus, O lord, we laud — do we praise you? Do we blame? We do not think.
sanskrit_cite: ko guṇair adhikas tvattas tvattaḥ ko nirguṇo 'dhikaḥ iti nātha numaḥ kiṃ tvāṃ kiṃ nindāmo na manmahe

plain_english: Even in praising, of the nectar-flood — of which favour is your fruit — that to drink, who else is capable — how much more to give, O world-lord?
sanskrit_cite: kīrtane 'py amṛtaughasya yatprasatteḥ phalaṃ tava tat pātum api ko 'nyo 'laṃ kim u dātuṃ jagatpate

plain_english: From treasury of accomplishment of hosts of wholly desirable things — from you, devotion to you alone to obtain I pray, O lord, in every way.
sanskrit_cite: niḥśeṣaprārthanīyārthasārthasiddhinidhānataḥ tvattas tvadbhaktim evāptuṃ prārthaye nātha sarvathā

plain_english: Bow to three-world-lord, to you, O Bhava — of those attending you — to unimpeded power giving three-world-lordship.
sanskrit_cite: namas trailokyanāthāya tubhyaṃ bhava bhavajjuṣām trilokīnāthatādānanirvināyakaśaktaye

plain_english: Of abandoning all suffering the cause who — when in such doubt — O master, 'he you are' having decided — who has not gone to you as refuge?
sanskrit_cite: niḥśeṣakleśahānasya hetuḥ ka iti saṃśaye svāmin so 'sīti niścitya kas tvāṃ na śaraṇaṃ gataḥ

plain_english: Having enjoyed enjoyments, having dropped becoming-delusion, I will attain the supreme state — thus the hope here: may it shine supremely of the devout in Śambhu.
sanskrit_cite: bhuktvā bhogān bhavabhrāntiṃ hitvā lapsye paraṃ padam ity āśaṃseha śobheta śambhau bhaktimataḥ param

plain_english: O lord, even in dream whatever I may do or say, good or bad — with pride of dependence on you — everywhere here I am content.
sanskrit_cite: nātha svapne 'pi yat kuryāṃ brūyāṃ vā sādhv asādhu vā tvadadhīnatvadarpeṇa sarvatrātrāsmi nirvṛtaḥ

plain_english: Of lights even which light — there in your abode of the running mind — O lord of mind, touch of darkness — I think, barren-woman's-son's-younger-brother.
sanskrit_cite: jyotiṣām api yaj jyotis tatra tvaddhāmni dhāvataḥ cittasyeśa tamaḥsparśo manye vandhyātmajānujaḥ

plain_english: I think, foot placed even on the benign path of liberation — stands whose wish: 'I will serve Śiva' — this.
sanskrit_cite: manye nyastapadaḥ so 'pi kṣemye mokṣasya vartmani manorathaḥ sthito yasya seviṣye śivam ity ayam

plain_english: By maintenance, origin, dissolutions, in services of three worlds here — alone indeed, O lord, your power — free — the loom you oversee.
sanskrit_cite: sthityutpattilayair lokatrayasyopakriyāsv iha ekaiveśa bhavacchaktiḥ svatantraṃ tantram īkṣase

plain_english: In three worlds here who is saved, by triple suffering not afflicted — to him let bow be, to you — who you are that extinction-nectar-lake.
sanskrit_cite: trilokyām iha kas trātas tritāpyā nopatāpitaḥ tasmai namo 'stu te yas tvaṃ tannirvāṇāmṛtahradaḥ

plain_english: Even artificial devotion to you has genuine fruit arising — if this were guileless, what-fruited — by you let it be said.
sanskrit_cite: kṛtrimāpi bhavadbhaktir akṛtrimaphalodayā niśchadmā ced bhaved eṣā kiṃphaleti tvayocyatām

plain_english: That eye by which you are seen, that way by which you are reached — that fruit, O unborn, is born — which is from the wish-tree of talk about you.
sanskrit_cite: tac cakṣur īkṣyase yena sā gatir gamyase yayā phalaṃ tad aja jātaṃ yat tvatkathākalpapādapāt

plain_english: Better than good indeed is this — above, in you, which standing — for removing obstacles to that, you, O lord, are my refuge.
sanskrit_cite: śreyasā śreya evaitad upari tvayi yā sthitiḥ tadantarāyahṛtaye tvam īśa śaraṇaṃ mama

plain_english: Ah, sweetest is the nectar-taste of hoping to serve Śarva — where in a mere digit of time does it not become ever-fresh?
sanskrit_cite: aho svādutamaḥ śarvasevāśaṃsāsudhārasaḥ kutra kālakalāmātre na yo navanavāyate

plain_english: Again and again untiring, three worlds with hundreds of imaginings imagining even — who yet one, undifferentiated, conquers — unborn.
sanskrit_cite: muhur muhur aviśrāntas trailokyaṃ kalpanāśataiḥ kalpayann api ko 'py eko nirvikalpo jayaty ajaḥ

plain_english: By the knowledge-lamp burning the wick of transmigration-latencies anointed with stain-oil — O god, when to you may I be present, pray?
sanskrit_cite: malatailāktasaṃsāravāsanāvartidāhinā jñānadīpena deva tvāṃ kadā nu syām upasthitaḥ

plain_english: Even one wink, if fault-waned you make foot in mind — then, O Śambhu, what will you not accomplish?
sanskrit_cite: nimeṣam api yady ekaṃ kṣīṇadoṣe kariṣyasi padaṃ citte tadā śambho kiṃ na sampādayiṣyasi

plain_english: 'Blessed I am, duty done I am, great I am' — thus conviction would be with-support — his who has you as support, O lord.
sanskrit_cite: dhanyo 'smi kṛtakṛtyo 'smi mahān asmīti bhāvanā bhavet sālambanā tasya yas tvadālambanaḥ prabho

plain_english: Of all auspicious and inauspicious yourself the doer you are — but devotion to you is mother of auspicious alone, O lord, only.
sanskrit_cite: śubhāśubhasya sarvasya svayaṃ kartā bhavān api bhavadbhaktis tu jananī śubhasyaiveśa kevalam

plain_english: When mind is clear, O master — do you enter, or from your entering does it clear — thus the person swings.
sanskrit_cite: prasanne manasi svāmin kiṃ tvaṃ niviśase kim u tvatpraveśāt prasīdet tad iti dolāyate janaḥ

plain_english: But this certainty here — supervision by you alone indeed — grace of mind, O master — that is accomplishment, that supreme state.
sanskrit_cite: niścayaḥ punar eṣo 'tra tvadadhiṣṭhānam eva hi prasādo manasaḥ svāmin sā siddhis tat paraṃ padam

plain_english: Speech and mind and deed and my body — which, O lord — by your grace may that be ornamented alone with devotion to you.
sanskrit_cite: vacaś cetaś ca kāryaṃ ca śarīraṃ mama yat prabho tvatprasādena tad bhūyād bhavadbhāvaikabhūṣaṇam

plain_english: The wish-jewel of praise, giving rich fruits of wishes, abode of devotion's fortune — O Śambhu — Bhaṭṭanārāyaṇa made.
sanskrit_cite: stavacintāmaṇiṃ bhūrimanorathaphalapradam bhaktilakṣmyālayaṃ śambho bhaṭṭanārāyaṇo vyadhāt

plain_english: By sweet speech mind-captivating, by seeing, by being seen — conquers whose greatness is manifest bliss — supreme lord.
sanskrit_cite: sugirā cittahāriṇyā paśyantyā dṛśyamānayā jayaty ullāsitānandamahimā parameśvaraḥ
